messages:
tai: Quick heads-up — I opened a TF + helm PR to switch inference-worker Deployment updateStrategy -> Recreate for the PVC migration window. Asking for a quick sanity-check before I merge later today. TL;DR: replicas stay at 3, HPA still active, remove maxSurge/maxUnavailable, add preStop sleep(10s) to let connections drain. Secret env var name changed (INF_WORKER_KEY -> INFER_KEY) so helm values need to be patched. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/827

priya: Why Recreate vs RollingUpdate? curious about impact on availability.

tai: Good q. RollingUpdate leaves old + new together which causes PVC attach conflicts for the migration (we're moving from hostPath -> CSI in-place). Recreate will take a short outage per pod but avoids attach races. Plan is to shift traffic off cluster for ~5m during migration and do a staggered deployment (one pod at a time).

jonathan: HPA will still scale during this? If a pod goes down HPA might try to spin up new, how are we preventing overlapping attach?

priya: ^ this. also need to ensure PodDisruptionBudget doesn't block.

tai: HPA still on; strategy is to set HPA minReplicas=1 during migration (we're currently at min=3) and scale back after. PDB will be bumped to allow 0 unavailable for the short window. I'll include these as post-merge ops steps in the PR desc.

tai: snippet of the helm values I changed (in PR):
```yaml
updateStrategy: Recreate
preStop: |
  sleep 10
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 500m
    memory: 1Gi
  limits:
    cpu: 2
    memory: 4Gi
env:
  INFER_KEY: {{ .Values.secrets.inferKey }}
```

priya: Secret rename ok, but ops needs a heads-up for KMS rotation. Where's the new secret path?

tai: New KMS path: projects/redwood/secrets/infer-worker/key. infra-bot linked the TF change to update secret resource.

infra-bot: terraform plan: https://ci.internal/job/infra-plan/827 — shows resource update for k8s_deployment.inference_worker (strategy -> Recreate) and kubernetes_secret.infer_worker (name change). No replacements of PVs expected per plan.

k8s-bot: lint OK. readinessProbe unchanged; liveness probe still present. Suggestion: extend readiness initialDelaySeconds from 5 -> 10 for slower startup after migration.

jonathan: +1 to readiness bump. Also add a short canary: patch service selector to point 1 pod for 5 minutes, smoke tests, then flip. Helps catch issues without full rollout.

priya: Can you add an explicit terraform taint step for the old secret resource so we ensure recreate during apply? I can schedule rotation post-apply.

tai: Will do. Plan for timeline: merge after 18:00 PST, schedule 18:30 migration window, set HPA minReplicas=1 and PDB allow 0, flip service canary to 1 pod, run smoke, then promote. I'll post a one-line runbook in the PR.

jonathan: Sounds good. I can monitor logs + attaches during the run.

priya: I reviewed the PR comments, left one nits about the Helm chart comment. Otherwise :thumbsup:.

tai: Thanks all. Merging in ~45m unless anyone objects. If it looks risky we'll gate to tomorrow AM.

k8s-bot: CI: deploy-chart-check passed. image-scans ok.

infra-bot: apply scheduled at 18:30 PST (ticket #INF-412).

tai: Merged. Will update thread after apply and when smoke tests pass.

priya: Thanks — standing by for the smoke results.

jonathan: +1, will jump in if we see attach errors.
